topPRs.title: sep/111 + eth/075: Soneium SystemConfig owner to Foundation Upgrade Safe
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Transfers ownership of the Soneium Minato and Soneium Mainnet `SystemConfigProxy` from the Soneium SystemConfig owner Safes to the Foundation Upgrade Safe, ahead of the Soneium migration cutovers. Each task is a single `SystemConfig.transferOwnership(address)` call executed by the current owner: `0xB278818732E5BEbb742dc4Aa0617ccd1Dec76b65` (2-of-5) on Minato and `0x509182eC226b3B71D36A3255A80EF0b1A9D43033` (3-of-5) on Mainnet.

Same template and shape as #1560 (Unichain) and eth/065 / sep/104 (Ink): `TransferSystemConfigOwnership` with `safeAddressString = "SystemConfigOwner"`, so the signer is the owner discovered on-chain. SystemConfig 4.0.0 is single-step `Ownable`, so the transfer is effective on execution.

| Task | SystemConfigProxy | New owner | Nonce pin |
|---|---|---|---|
| sep/111 | `0x4Ca9608Fef202216bc21D543798ec854539bAAd3` | `0xDEe57160aAfCF04c34C887B5962D0a69676d3C8B` (Sepolia FUS) | 32 |
| eth/075 | `0x7A8Ed66B319911A0F3E7288BDdAB30d9c0C875c3` | `0x847B5c174615B1B7fDF770882256e2D3E95b9D92` (FUS) | 22 |

Nonces are the live values on 2026-10-01; calldata and domain/message/safe hashes were re-derived independently with `cast` and match `just simulate-stack`. Both tasks stay DRAFT until the execution dates are fixed; the hashes move if the owner Safes sign anything else before then.

topPRs.title: [CONTINGENCY] eth/088: Soneium Mainnet rollback of batcher + unsafe block signer
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Contingency rollback for the Soneium Mainnet sequencer + batcher cutover in #1566. Kept as a separate PR and merged only if it is needed, same as the Ink rollback in #1493.

`eth/088` restores Sony's batcher `0x6776BE80dBAda6A02B5F2095cF13734ac303B8d1` and unsafe block signer `0x7c2Bd59ee2a2C7391c9A240132f26071e9546262` (the live values before `eth/085`) on the Soneium `SystemConfigProxy`, signed by the FoundationUpgradeSafe, which stays the SystemConfig owner. The proposer has no rollback: the OPE proposer (`eth/084`) keeps working whichever party runs the sequencer and batcher.

It is pinned to FoundationUpgradeSafe nonce 82, so it can be signed ahead of the Nov 19 ceremony and executed within minutes. That nonce is shared with the foundation approval of `eth/086` (fee vaults), so only one of the two can execute. `eth/086` should be executed only once the cutover is confirmed. If the rollback executes instead, `eth/086` and every later FUS task (`eth/087`) move up by one nonce and are re-signed. The status is `CANCELLED (CONTINGENCY TASK, SIGN AS NEEDED)` so `fetch-tasks.sh` leaves it out of the stacked simulation, where the shared nonce would otherwise fail the nonce check. It is simulated on its own, with state overrides for the post-`eth/085` owner, batcher and signer.

The calldata is `eth/085`'s with Sony's two addresses swapped in, checked byte for byte and decoded with `cast`. The standalone simulation passes, and the hashes in VALIDATION.md come from it.

topPRs.title: docs: mark eth tasks 085-087 as READY TO SIGN
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Sets the Soneium Mainnet migration tasks to `[READY TO SIGN]`:

- `eth/085-soneium-proposer-rotation`
- `eth/086-soneium-set-batcher-unsafe-signer`
- `eth/087-soneium-fee-vault`

The governance proposal for 085 and 087 has passed: https://vote.optimism.io/proposals/8035171538248904042498787875276023745344587634251247445608721030800258016994

Stacked simulation 084 → 087 reproduces every domain and message hash in the VALIDATION.md files, and the nonce pins match on-chain state (L1PAO 48, FoundationUpgradeSafe 79, SecurityCouncil 75 before 084).

`eth/089-op-mainnet-set-unsafe-signer` is already `[CANCELLED]` on main.
